Name: Longer Days
Author: StuykGaming
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/7tj69Rc.png[/img]﻿﻿[/left]
[size=4][b]Longer Days[/b][/size]
[size=3]Play at your own configurable pace by making days much longer, regaining stamina by sitting, or even passing the time by sitting.
[/size][size=3]The aim of this mod is to enhance the vanilla aspects of the game without ruining the core game loop.

[b][i]This mod does not pause your game time or monsters.[/i][/b]

[/size][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Configure how many seconds in real life there are for every 10 minutes in-game.[/size]
[*][size=3]Toggle if sitting should pass time.[/size]
[*][size=3]Toggle if stamina is restored while sitting.[/size]
[*][size=3]Configure how much stamina is gained while time passes.[/size]
[*][size=3]NPC(s) speed up their schedules to accommodate for your time passing.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][list]
[*]Install SMAPI 3.18.6+
[*]Place folder in the Mods folder
[/list]
[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[/b][size=3]This mod may not be compatible with other time modification mods or time-based cheats.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Main file; remember not to use other time modification mods.
